//: Tells Pylance / Pyright where this repo's import roots actually are.
Without this, opening the repo root shows dozens of false 'Import could not
be resolved' errors across evals/gate0. The code is correct -- the modules
are imported flat (`from exercise_lib import ...`, `from detector.adapter
import ...`) and resolve because the harness runs with evals/gate0 on
sys.path, while gate_config.py additionally puts backend/ on sys.path so
`app.core.config` resolves. An editor opened at the repo root knows none of
that and flags every one of those imports.
extraPaths mirrors the two roots the runtime actually uses:
evals/gate0 -> exercise_lib, gate_config, golden_loader, detector, scorers
This file changes editor analysis only. It has no effect on runtime, the
tests, the eval gate, or the Docker image.
//optional-deps: The pose_capture adapters probe for mediapipe / tensorflow / tensorflow_hub
/ rtmlib inside try-except ImportError to report whether a runtime is
installed. They are deliberately absent from requirements.txt -- the offline
detector path is stdlib-only and the API image carries no pose runtime at
all (the privacy invariant). Flagging them as missing is noise.
